sources_legend.SL: winnerdata.leads / Tracerfy skip-trace data already purchased -- do not re-purchase
sources_legend.MCA: public.multi_county_auctions (the auction that created this lead)
sources_legend.PC: producer call only -- not available from any queried source, must be asked live

improved.note: true only when num_buildings > 0 is FLP-confirmed; null (not false) when FLP has no row for this county/parcel -- never guessed

_doctrine_notes.umbrella: umbrella_quote_requested = true when total_wins >= 2 (ABP) OR this buyer has multiple leads in the current delivered batch. umbrella_limit = 1000000 base, 2000000 when total_deployed > 250000.
_doctrine_notes.flood: flood_if_indicated is INFERRED from a static FL coastal-county list, not a verified FEMA flood-zone lookup -- zone_code is not populated in FLP for these parcels yet. Tag flood_basis='INFERRED_coastal_county_heuristic' whenever used; never present as VERIFIED.
_doctrine_notes.commercial_bop: true when dor_use_code indicates a commercial DOR use class OR num_buildings > 2.
_doctrine_notes.master_policy: master_policy_conversation = true only when total_wins >= 5 (portfolio-scale buyer).
_doctrine_notes.must_quote: [product_line, umbrella_if_multi_property, flood_if_indicated, builders_risk_if_renovation] -- only include the conditional ones when their flag is true.
_doctrine_notes.readiness_score: percent of the 12 carrier-required fields (entity_name, contact_name, contact_phone, address, county, year_built, sqft, num_buildings, construction_class, dor_use_code, sold_amount, auction_date) that are non-null.
